2603: H.1.1     Gaining from Supply. When a player’s score
2604: marker enters a space with a hireling marker, they

2612: to the die roll. They count only the gold die pips
2613: if they have the most victory points or are tied for
2614: the most; they count all the die pips otherwise (in­
2615: cluding if they have activated a dominance card).

2617: player’s turn, they must remove one control mark­
2618: er from each hireling card they gained on previ­

2622: the player with the highest score). That player puts the
2623: hireling marker below their Evening (as a remind­
2624: er) and immediately rolls for control (H.1.2).

2644: H.3.1     Rule. A hireling’s controller treats hireling piec­

2650: other than its controller and players in coalition

2663: troller’s abilities, crafted persistent effects, or am­
2664: bush cards. (So, a hireling could not use Boat Builders
2665: while moving, and the Highway Bandits could not be
2666: placed on a river. A hireling’s controller could not play
2667: an ambush card while battling with the hireling.)

2672: and tokens, even when defending in battle against the
